title: Grade 12 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   C. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   D. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   D. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.
   B. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.
   D. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected chapter Surah Yusuf and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. D — Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. B — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Science of Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Science of Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Hadith; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
